exposure: Indication for OR/ER (failure of autologous assisted reproductive technology, POI, genetic disease carrier)
cohort: 584 cycles from 194 individual patients who underwent OR/ER at a tertiary fertility centre from 2001 until 2020.
finding: The indication for OR/ER does not significantly impact reproductive or obstetric outcomes, except for POI due to Turner syndrome or treatment with chemotherapy/radiotherapy, which may be associated with impaired outcomes.
